title: Lattice Studies of Two-Dimensional Maximally Supersymmetric Yang-Mills Theory for Tests of Gauge-Gravity Duality
summary: We present our ongoing work on two-dimensional maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills (2D MSYM) theory using lattice techniques. The continuum theory is obtained from the dimensional reduction of four-dimensional ${\mathcal N} = 4$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory. We construct both the continuum and lattice versions of the 2D MSYM theory. The lattice action preserves a subset of supersymmetries. We extend existing lattice software with new routines to accommodate the additional terms in the lower-dimensional theory.
